WeSpeaker VoxCeleb ResNet34: WeSpeaker/VoxCeleb model (CC BY 4.0); software Apache 2.0.
Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/speaker-recongition-models
Model license: https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wespeaker/blob/master/docs/pretrained.md
Segmentation: pyannote segmentation 3.0, quantized ONNX conversion distributed by sherpa-onnx. MIT, CNRS 2022. Models are unmodified.

Runtime: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 (Apache 2.0), includes ONNX Runtime (MIT).
